title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text: Welcomes the Parliament’s environmental management system (EMAS) targets for 2025-2029; welcomes the investments in infrastructure as part of the planned energy efficiency and environmental renovation actions foreseen between 2025 and 2029, which is a good method of achieving value for money; takes note of the budget of EUR 8,97 million for investments on energy efficiency and environment in the 2027 estimates to further improve the environmental performance of its buildings; notes that this corresponds to an increase of 6,1 % compared to the 2026 budget; welcomes that Parliament has installed and is continuing to install photovoltaic solar panels to further increase the share of renewable energy produced on-site; stresses the need to ensure that such investments deliver measurable efficiency gains, also given the geopolitical context and to achieve long-term cost savings;
